data.title: A calmer room starts with light
data.name: room-lighting-1010
data.summary: Three ways to make a room feel brighter, without changing its footprint.
data.content:
Start with the window. Keep the space around it clear, then layer one task light with a warm accent.

Natural materials soften the contrast and bring the room together.
